label: Gentle Muse · Fall
contract: Every holiday carries a fact somebody softened. I post the real one before the day arrives.

beats.html:
R.L. Stine was writing them
at roughly one a month.

Fast, cheap, for children,
and dismissed by
every serious critic.

It taught a generation
that a short chapter ending
on a hook is worth finishing.

Somebody you know learned
to read from these.
Not from the good books.
